GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing a head, was crossed at 700m theh immediately shifted Two Wide and Moved Up to trail 0.75 Lengths turning, hit Lead 350m, raced clear early in Straight and kept going to post # solid win

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, enjoyed run of the race, railed up to within 1.25 Lengths turning, pocketed entering turn, off heels at 350m, hit Lead 160m, went clear and kept going to post. [Stewards: COT - Rider instructed to use the whip sparingly.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was instructed to use whip only sparingly. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & 3.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths rail turning, hugged rail and improved rounding turn, off heels at 200m, ran on hitting Lead at the 60m, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m was eased after improving up onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , on rail by the 700m, trailed 4 Lengths rail turning, hugged fence rounding turn and Made Some Ground along rail in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. Wanted to lay in throughout.] # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages. Wanted to lay in throughout. Near the 900m, when laying in, had to be eased when close to the heels of NORTH OF ELI.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, Drifted Back to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and picked up a length on the straightening leader but never looked a serious threat to the winner. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages. Hung in from 300m to finish.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Inclined to lay in throughout. Near the 300m when laying in, shifted in abruptly. Then commenced to hang in for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Ridden Along Went Forward Lead early Settled Down 2nd 2 then 1 Lengths off leader/winner , Took over @ 300m then couldn't finish off and was gone @ 100m - # slow recov/thumps
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight,

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 3 Wide joint Lead at 700m, in Two Wide at 650m, led Two Wide jointly turning, took Lead at 250m and got away, kicked clear and went to the line under hands'n'heels only the final 50m # bolted in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced three wide without cover until crossing to join the lead near the 600m.
Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled restraining looking to slot in settled down 8 Lengths off the lead (800m), closer before Turn , wider for home trying to make Ground , couldn't # no run on straight

Jumped Ok Not Bustled Drifted Back Settled Down Off Mid-Field 3 Wide 5 Lengths off leader/winner with a trail x 700 6th 4 Lengths , clear run home Outside quickened from 300 run ended 100m (b/ag) # 3 wide, gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 700m, became awkward in its stride whilst racing in restricted room for a short distance. Raced wide. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.
